resources.string: Reminds you to export an encrypted backup when the last one is a month old.
Your last encrypted backup is from %1$s. Export a new one from Settings: if you forget your PIN, only a backup can restore your journal.
You have not exported an encrypted backup yet. Do it from Settings: if you forget your PIN, only a backup can restore your journal.
Spreadsheet files in a password-protected archive

The CSV files contain your health data. They are packed in an archive encrypted with a password (AES-256), which you choose in the next step. Open it with 7-Zip, Keka or a similar tool: Windows Explorer and some phone apps cannot read this format. Anyone who has the archive and the password can read your data: do not send them together.
Choose a password to protect the archive. You will need it to open the files.
If you forget this password, the archive cannot be opened. This export cannot be imported back into the app: use the encrypted backup for that.
The CSV export failed. Nothing was saved.
